title: The Hadza Gut Holds 730 Species—America Averages 277
hook: The Hadza gut carries 730 species; America's average carries 277.
closing: Modern food is safer, but low fiber may leave your gut ecosystem poorer.
question: How much fiber did you eat?

segments.say: The Hadza of Tanzania carry 730 gut bacteria species. The average American has 277, fewer than half as many.
The Hadza eat 150 grams of fiber daily, ten times the average American. More fiber feeds more kinds of bacteria.
The CDC says 34 percent of US antibiotic prescriptions are unnecessary. Each avoidable dose can reduce gut diversity.
